source_recording.access: macOS denied this task access to the copy stored under Messages attachments

reported_behavior: Tapping Instagram Post presents Apple's Open In application chooser before Instagram opens its own intermediate sharing screens and eventually reaches the New Post composer.
expected_behavior: Tapping Instagram Post first saves the rendered ticket to Photos and opens instagram://library with that asset's LocalIdentifier so Instagram can start with the ticket selected.
fallback_behavior: If iOS cannot open the unsupported Instagram library deep link, rec.me presents the existing .igo and com.instagram.exclusivegram document-interaction handoff, then the system share sheet if that route is unavailable.
root_cause: The supported implementation calls UIDocumentInteractionController.presentOpenInMenu, whose contract always presents an application-selection menu.
